name: travel-a2ui
description: A travel chat + itinerary builder whose backend is a managed agent that speaks A2UI Express.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @travel-a2ui/express && npm run build -w @travel-a2ui/renderer && npm run build -w @travel-a2ui/mcp-view && npm run build -w @travel-a2ui/web && npm run build -w @travel-a2ui/gallery
scripts.e2e: node tools/e2e/chat.mjs && node tools/e2e/interaction.mjs && node tools/e2e/frameworks.mjs && node tools/e2e/mcp.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/express packages/renderer && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit && tsc -p apps/mcp-view --noEmit && tsc -p apps/gallery --noEmit
scripts.generate: python3 scripts/build_catalog.py && python3 scripts/build_fixtures.py && python3 scripts/build_examples.py && python3 scripts/build_skills.py
scripts.check: npm run check:catalog && npm run check:examples && npm run check:skills && npm run check:prompt
scripts.screenshots: node tools/e2e/chat.mjs --screenshot docs/screenshots/01-chat-light.png && node tools/e2e/mcp.mjs --screenshot docs/screenshots/05-mcp-view.png && node tools/screenshots/capture.mjs docs/screenshots
